caption: Liudmyla Ryzhak, in her wedding dress, sits amid glass-strewn debris in her damaged Kyiv apartment.

Jersey City, New Jersey, US People observe a minute of silence honouring the victims of the September 11 terrorist attacks. The US marked the 25th anniversary with memorials and remembrance ceremonies across the country to honour the nearly 3,000 people killed.

New York City, US A US army warrant officer stands by a reflecting pool during a memorial on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks. Family members of victims gathered at the 9/11 Memorial Plaza as the names of those killed in the 9/11 attacks and the bombing of the World Trade Centre in 1993 were read aloud.

Kandahar, Afghanistan Girls attend a class at a primary school in Kandahar at the start of a new school year. Hundreds of thousands of Afghan women and girls have been deported from Iran and Pakistan in the past year to a life of severe restrictions.

Deir al-Balah, Gaza A Palestinian child looks at the funeral of three-year-old Saadi Ghalia, who was killed by an Israeli tank shell, in Deir al-Balah. Testimony from 24 Israeli military insiders ​on the secret ​systems used in ​the war on Gaza​ has been revealed in a new documentary film about the mass killing of Palestinian civilians .
Gaza Palestinians inspect the site of an Israeli strike on a house, carried out after the Israeli military warned residents to evacuate the area, at al-Shati camp in Gaza City.

Taybeh, West Bank Members of the Bedouin community from the West Bank village of Taybeh keep guard to prevent attacks by Israeli settlers from the nearby outpost. Prominent British rabbis have backed sanctions by Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary , on Israeli settlements, warning that the time for inaction on settler violence must come to an end.
Ceuta, Spain People look on as firefighters and police work in an area where a fire broke out, burning improvised migrant shelters.
Barcelona, Spain Police officers use batons to disperse far-left Catalan separatists trying to disrupt a rally by a far-right Catalan separatist party.

Kyiv, Ukraine Firefighters deal with the aftermath of a huge Russian missile and drone attack in Kyiv. Recent Russian strikes on food warehouses and logistics supply chains around several Ukrainian cities have left gaps on supermarket shelves and fears of price increases.

Kyiv, Ukraine A resident walks by a building hit during Russian missile and drone strikes in Kyiv. Ukraine’s capital has been attacked by a torrent of drone and missile strikes since late August, killing dozens of people and destroying infrastructure. As well as food warehouses, Russia has targeted e-commerce logistics hubs and stockpiles of medical supplies.
Palembang, Indonesia A firefighter uses a tree branch to try to extinguish flames amid a wildfire in Palembang .
Surakarta, Indonesia A helicopter drops water in an attempt to put out a fire at the Putri Cempo landfill.

Devighat, Nepal Residents commute across the Trishuli River on a newly installed zip wire in the aftermath of flash floods in Devighat. Nepal is demanding $20m (£15m) in climate compensation for the recent devastating floods, as a senior minister called on the world’s most polluting countries to ‘wake up’ and accept shared responsibility for a disaster that led to the death or disappearance of more than 6,000 people.

Nuwakot, Nepal Members of the Nepali army search and rescue team run for cover from heavy rain while looking for survivors beneath the mud in an area hit by flash floods and mudslides. Scientists believe the climate crisis had a role to play in the floods , which were triggered when a melting glacier partly collapsed and set off a deadly landslide and flash flooding through Chinese-controlled Tibet and Nepal in late August.
Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo A girl stands among the debris of a fire that ravaged a school in Bukavu. The fire caused a stampede that killed at least 14 children.
Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo Health workers prepare to transfer the body of Abineno Justine, a 38-year-old woman who died of the Ebola virus, to a coffin before her burial.
Havana, Cuba Followers of the Virgin of Regla – Yemayá in the Yoruba religion – take part in a procession during her feast day in Havana.

New York City, US Aryna Sabalenka of Belarus serves to Czechia’s Linda Nosková during the women’s quarter-final at the US Open in Flushing Meadows. There has been little evidence of vulnerability from Sabalenka during the tournament. She swept through Camila Osorio, Polina Iatcenko, Kamilla Rakhimova and Taylor Townsend without dropping a set before surviving her first serious examination against the Wimbledon champion Nosková in Tuesday’s quarter-final, coming through 7-6, 3-6, 7-6 after 2 hours and 22 minutes.

Jersey City, New Jersey, US People embrace at Liberty State Park during testing of the 9/11 Tribute in Light installation. Thousands gathered across the country on the 25th anniversary of the terrorist attacks to honour the memory of the victims.
Wild black pigs roam a Greek island beach in the water among sunbathing tourists.

Melbourne, Australia The Royal Australian Air Force Roulettes fly over the MCG stadium as players stand for the Australian national anthem during the NFL match between Los Angeles Rams and San Francisco 49ers.
Cromvoirt, Netherlands European fans show their sartorial support during the first day of the Solheim Cup golf tournament, contested between women’s teams from the US and Europe.
New York, US A model walks the runway for the Christian Siriano fashion show during New York Fashion Week.
Atokos, Greece A resident Mediterranean black pig takes a dip near paddleboarders at a beach on the uninhabited Ionian island.
London, UK Pollenarium , a new artwork by Luke Jerram, commissioned by Creative Barking and Dagenham, has its world premiere at Barking Riverside’s Emerge East festival.
Wiltshire, UK One of more than 100 hot-air balloons prepares to take off at the Icons of the Sky event at Longleat House.
Vercelli, Italy The Italian prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, at the opening of Risò, the international rice festival.
London, UK The Conservative party leader, Kemi Badenoch, during a visit to see the Bayeux tapestry, on display at the British Museum.

Birmingham, UK Fans dressed as Fred Flintstone hold up a cutout of the late Dolly Parton as they do the conga through the crowd during the cricket Test Match between England and Pakistan at Edgbaston.
London, UK The Labour MP Kim Leadbeater joins a gathering of supporters of the assisted dying pill in Parliament Square. MPs will again vote on the bill at it returns to parliament.
Barcelona, Spain Police officers use batons to disperse left-leaning Catalan separatists trying to disrupt a rally by far-right Catalan separatists.

Manila, Philippines Sara Duterte, the vice-president of the Philippines, arrives for a court appearance as she faces a potential impeachment trial for comments she made about President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
Kathmandu, Nepal A man makes his way through a flock of pigeons.

New York, US People leave flowers at a memorial before a ceremony commemorating the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center at the National 9/11 Memorial and Museum.
New York, US People listen to the U.S. national anthem at the memorial on the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.
New York, US Iris Weinshall, Chuck Schumer, Hillary Clinton, Bill Clinton, Michelle Obama and Barack Obama attend a ceremony commemorating the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11, 2001 attacks.
New York, US Firefighters march near the memorial on the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.
Salerno, Italy Rescued people trying to reach Europe wait to disembark from the Ocean Viking ship operated by the maritime-humanitarian organisation SOS Mediterranee.
Donetsk, Ukraine A Ukrainian service member from the special police Hyzhak Brigade prepares to launch a Blyskavka (Lightning) strike drone, towards Russian troops from a position near a frontline.
Kyiv, Ukraine A civilian reacts after a gas station is hit by a Russian drone.
Trishuli, Nepal A man carrying his belongings walks past a damaged house in the aftermath of the devastating flash floods.

Glasgow, UK The UK Aids Memorial Quilt is displayed in full for the first time in Scotland, at the Tramway in Glasgow. The quilt represents more than 600 people lost to HIV and Aids in the UK, and is part of the world’s largest community art project, started in the US in 1985 by the activist Cleve Jones.
Hyderabad, India A foot is painted of an idol of the elephant-headed Hindu deity Ganesha before the Ganesh Chaturthi festival.
Silhouettes of people seen from behind, viewing the Bayeux tapestry.
Sanaa, Yemen Fighters loyal to the Houthi authorities march during a recruitment rally.
Khan Younis, Gaza A Palestinian woman carries a toddler as smoke rises from a house targeted in an Israeli strike.
Mansouri, Lebanon Smoke clouds a hillside after an Israeli airstrike on the town.
Devighat, Nepal A man pours mud out of a window as the clear-up continues after deadly flash floods.
Los Angeles, US A Chinook helicopter drops water on a wildfire burning in the hills near the Getty Center.

Taguig City, Philippines Activists hold a rally during the opening day of the inaugural Luzon Economic Corridor Investment Forum, to raise concerns about foreign involvement in the domestic economy and the potential impact on agricultural and ancestral lands.
Bangkok, Thailand Counterfeit watches are smashed during a ceremony to destroy goods infringing intellectual property.
London, UK The Lady in Blue sculpture, by the artist Tschabalala Self, is unveiled on Trafalgar Square’s Fourth Plinth.
Dallas, Texas A Donald Trump fan arrives for the first day of the Republican midterm convention.

London, UK Bertie the English Bulldog and its owner, the Labour MP for Bournemouth West, Jessica Toale, take part in the Westminster Dog of the Year competition, in which politicians and their pets compete for the title while promoting canine welfare and responsible dog ownership.
Athens, Greece The actor Katerina Misichroni, playing the role of high priestess, lights a torch from the cauldron during the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games flame handover ceremony.
London, UK Some of the first visitors to the Bayeux tapestry at the British Museum gaze at it.
